Hanoi: Vietnamese cuisine
Jul 2023
Lunch in Hanoi. 
Since breakfast was at a restaurant with a local atmosphere, for lunch they took us to a restaurant where we could enjoy various Vietnamese dishes. 

We were seated on the second floor, and the restaurant was frequented by both locals and tourists, including groups of tourists like us and locals who were celebrating with their families. 
The menu was very extensive. 

You can compare the fresh spring rolls and fried spring rolls. 
The crispy fried squid had a crispy batter. 
The braised pork in clay pot came out and was different from what I had imagined. 
It tasted like braised pork, with a slightly sweet and spicy taste like Taiwanese lu rou fan. 
It was a taste that made me want to have white rice. 

Fresh spring rolls 
Fried spring rolls, Saigon style 
Fried spring rolls, Hanoi style 
Stir-fried spinach 
Crispy fried squid 
Braised pork in clay pot 
Alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks for each person 
Total 1,300,000VND (about 7,900 yen)

Vietnamese Cuisine
Aug 2019
Glad to have went here for our last day in Hanoi. Easy walk from our hotel Sofitel Metropole. We saw many locals and Japanese eating here. This place is authentic Vietnamese food! A few of the places we tried our first few nights that were highly rated on TripAdvisor were all tourist trap places. Places that ask for good reviews and made you write a review for them right there and then! How appalling! Lol. Anyway, glad I scrolled down to #228 to find Cay Cau on the last night of Hanoi. We ordered the papaya salad and chayote with garlic and both dishes were excellent. The papaya at first tasted a bit on the sweet side, but we added fresh chopped chilies and the spiciness balanced the taste nicely. We had a steam grouper fish and it was very fresh/ delicious but a bit on the expensive side 750k dong but still cheap compare to back home in USA. Place is clean and good service here. They did tack on 10% service charge automatically to our bill. First time to see that done in Vietnam. Just as we walked out from dinner around 19:00. We saw 2 lady’s setting up to play traditional musical instrument inside the restaurant. That might have been nice to watch while eating dinner.

Dine in Greenery
Aug 2018
Located in one of the greenest area in Hanoi. Like a restaurant in the garden. Great place to be for 2 or more. We accommodate both 2nd and 3rd floors and they manage to served us accordingly. All staff are very friendly and helpful. Everyone play their part and know what to do next. Thanks to Mr Big the Restaurant Manager who give the best suggestion for our group. Not only that he did explain what and why the food are all about in this beautiful restaurant. Decorated beautifully and very artistic. 2nd time here and they never failed me. This is one of the best place to dine in style and at the most greenest area ever in Hanoi. Even Cay Cau located nearby with other restaurant this place have special cuisine that you must try when visit this area. Mr Big - always suggest us with what to eat and try while eating here. Verity of taste and i would recommend you to try this restaurant.
